svg.title: AutoTrust · ScienceGuru · Guru Turbo 1.2: NanoGPT training-time comparison
svg.desc: ScienceGuru (AutoTrust · Guru Turbo 1.2; measured NanoGPT training result): 24.8998 seconds; ANVIL2: 39.914 seconds; Exact-match: 47.2056 seconds; Official SOTA: approximately 67.56 seconds; Recursive: approximately 75.36 seconds; PACEvolve: 140.2 seconds; NorMuon: approximately 140.70 seconds; Enigma: approximately 179.40 seconds. Sources and experimental context are documented in docs/BASELINES.md.
